# Hello World

Use the Hello World skill to respond to the user when they enter the phrase "hello word".

1. Run the [script](./scripts/get-sysinfo.js) to obtain system information.

2. Respond with "Hello World" in ascii format

3. Provide the System Information obtained from the script in step 1.
